title: Kathryn A NDE 5299
content: I was driving too fast in the rain. When I applied the brakes, in order to slow down for the oncoming curve and bridge, my car hydroplaned, spun around, and slammed into the sign marking the bridge. The car hit the sign so forcefully that the front seat passenger door was so crushed that it nearly touched my right elbow. The force of that impact flipped my car upside down, over the side of the bridge, and into the water. I cried out to God for help. I was telepathically told, ‘Take a deep breath.’ I do not remember the impact. But when I opened my eyes, my car was upside down at the bottom of a stream. My seat belt was on. All the glass in the car had broken, and my car was filled with water. The first thing I noticed was the absence of time and space. I was most definitely upside down in my car under water, but I was in another dimension of that reality. As I looked around, I felt no fear whatsoever. I felt calm and safe, warm and at home. Everywhere I looked, I saw what appeared to be colorful rainbow bursts of flying bright energies. I knew I was dead and began to telepathically express the thought that, other than missing my children, I was thrilled to be home. I began to ask, ‘How do I get out of here? I am so happy to be home! Get me out of this car!’ I was lovingly told that I had more work to do. I was specifically instructed to take off my seat belt and get out of the car. I was shown something that appeared to me only in my thoughts for that moment, and that gave me the desire to return. I took off my seat belt and crawled through the space where the window used to be. As I began to rise, I asked, ‘How long do I have to hold my breath?’ and immediately the answer came, ‘As long as it takes.’ When I surfaced and took in a breath, in that moment, I was fully back in this dimension, time, and space, and very cold and wet. I decided I would need my purse, because somehow I knew the police would be coming and I would need my ID. I tried to go back into the water, but it was so cold, it took my breath away, and I could not do it. An angel pulled me out of the water. I may say ‘an angel’, but he looked like a truck driver. As he pulled me out of the water, he said he had called the police and an ambulance and explained that he was there to help me. Because he had seen me trying to go back into the water, he asked if there was someone else in the car. I said no, I just wanted my purse. He laughed and helped me up the hill to the bridge, where the police and ambulance had just arrived. I had a cut on my forehead, and as the ambulance driver was wrapping my head, and the policeman was saying it was a miracle that I survived. The truck driver/angel walked between the two of them and handed me my purse! Then in the literal blink of an eye, the truck driver and his truck were gone. Later, when my car was pulled out of the water, it was really shocking to see. Like I said earlier, the front passenger door was crushed to my right elbow and the hood of the car was nearly on the back seat. To look at it, no one would believe anyone could have survived.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described seeing 'colorful rainbow bursts of flying bright energies' and being 'in another dimension of that reality' while the car was underwater.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She was told she 'had more work to do' and was instructed to remove her seat belt and get out of the car.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic instructions ('Take a deep breath'; 'As long as it takes') and a sense of being 'in another dimension' with no fear, calm/safe, and 'home'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience occurred while still perceiving herself in the submerged car; no tunnel/OBE described; return involved following instructions to exit the car and then surfacing back into normal time/space.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She reported being physically upside down underwater while also being 'in another dimension of that reality' with an absence of time/space.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: NDE-like state described as occurring while still located in the submerged car, with 'absence of time and space' and 'colorful rainbow bursts of flying bright energies.' Also reported a 'truck driver/angel' who disappeared along with his truck after handing her purse to her.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Take a deep breath.” “As long as it takes.” “I felt calm and safe, warm and at home.” “I had more work to do.”
